                                                   19   TO THE CLERK OF THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE NORTHERN

                                                   20   DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA, ALL PARTIES AND THEIR COUNSEL OF RECORD:

                                                   21          Pursuant to 28 U.S.C. §§ 1332 and 1441, defendant Elevance Health, Inc. (“Defendant” or

                                                   22   “Elevance”) hereby removes this action from the Superior Court of California, County of Santa

                                                   23   Clara, to the United States District Court for the Northern District of California, San Jose Division,

                                                   24   and states that removal is proper for the reasons stated below.

                                                   25         TIMELINESS AND COMPLIANCE WITH PROCEDURAL REQUIREMENTS

                                                   26          1.      Plaintiff Imagine360 Administrators, LLC (“Plaintiff”) filed this case in the Superior

                                                   27   Court of California, County of Santa Clara on July 1, 2026, Case No. 26CV497472, captioned

                                                   28   Imagine360 Administrators v. Elevance Health, Inc. (the “State Court Action”).

                                                                                                         -1-
                                                                                              NOTICE OF REMOVAL
                                     Case 5:26-cv-08365-NC           Document 1       Filed 08/12/26       Page 2 of 5



                             1          2.      Defendant was served was served with the Complaint on July 14, 2026. A copy of

                             2   all “process, pleadings, and orders” received by Defendant in the State Court Action is attached as

                             3   Exhibit A. See 28 U.S.C. § 1446(a). Upon information and belief, no other related process,

                             4   pleadings, or orders have been served.

                             5          3.      This Notice of Removal is timely, as it is filed within thirty days of service of the

                             6   Complaint. See 28 U.S.C. § 1446(b).

                             7          4.      Under 28 U.S.C. §§ 84(a) and 1441(a) and Civil L.R. 3-2(e), this action can be

                             8   removed to this Court because this District and Division embrace the Superior Court of California,

                             9   Santa Clara County, which is the place in which Plaintiff originally filed the State Court Action.

                            10          5.      Promptly upon filing this Notice of Removal, Defendant shall file a Notice of Filing

                            11   of Notice of Removal, with a copy of the Notice of Removal, with the Superior Court of California,
TROUTMAN PEPPER LOCKE LLP




                            12   Santa Clara County and will serve a copy thereof on Plaintiff through its counsel, pursuant to 28
   11682 EL CAMINO REAL

    SAN DIEGO, CA 92130
         SUITE 400




                            13   U.S.C. § 1446(d).

                            14          6.      Elevance is the only named Defendant. Elevance consents to the removal of this

                            15   action and has been served with process.

                            16          7.       The Complaint alleges Elevance failed to pay fees purportedly owed pursuant to a

                            17   services agreement, and asserts a single cause of action against Elevance for breach of contract. See

                            18   Ex. A at 7–13 (“Compl.”).

                            19                                      GROUNDS FOR REMOVAL

                            20          8.       Under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a), “any civil action brought in a State court of which the

                            21   district courts of the United States have original jurisdiction, may be removed by the defendant or

                            22   defendants, to the district court of the United States for the district and division embracing the place

                            23   where such action is pending.”

                            24          9.      This Court’s subject matter jurisdiction and the basis for removal are founded upon

                            25   diversity of citizenship of the parties pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1332(a), which states, in relevant part,

                            26   that “[t]he district courts shall have original jurisdiction of all civil actions where the matter in

                            27   controversy exceeds the sum or value of $75,000, exclusive of interest and costs, and is

                            28   between…(1) citizens of different States….”

                                                                                  -2-
                                                                          NOTICE OF REMOVAL
                                     Case 5:26-cv-08365-NC          Document 1        Filed 08/12/26     Page 3 of 5



                             1          10.     Removal is justified because there is complete diversity among the parties.

                             2   Defendant Elevance is an Indiana corporation with its principal place of businesses in Indiana. See

                             3   Ex. A at 8 (Compl. ¶ 8). For diversity purposes, Defendant is a citizen of Indiana.

                             4          11.     The Complaint alleges that Plaintiff is a Texas limited liability company with its

                             5   principal place of business in Pennsylvania. See Ex. A at 8 (Compl. ¶ 5).

                             6          12.     The citizenship of the LLC members is not alleged. See Johnson v. Columbia

                             7   Properties Anchorage, LP, 437 F.3d 894, 899 (9th Cir. 2006) (for purposes of diversity, an LLC has

                             8   the citizenship of each of its members). On information and belief, Plaintiff’s members are citizens

                             9   of Texas, Florida, and Pennsylvania, but not Indiana.

                            10          13.     Based on the foregoing, there is complete diversity because Plaintiff and Defendant

                            11   are citizens of different states. 28 U.S.C. § 1332. See also Giannattasio v. McLaren Auto., Inc., No.
TROUTMAN PEPPER LOCKE LLP




                            12   23-CV-00066-WHO, 2023 WL 3138979, at *4 (N.D. Cal. Mar. 26, 2023) (finding that allegations
   11682 EL CAMINO REAL

    SAN DIEGO, CA 92130
         SUITE 400




                            13   regarding the parties’ citizenship provided a sufficient basis for removal).

                            14          14.     Plaintiff has demanded $447,878.22 in its Complaint, plus pre-judgment interest at a

                            15   rate of 5% per annum. Ex. A at 11, 13 (Compl. ¶ 41 & Prayer for Relief ¶ D). Based on the

                            16   Complaint’s allegations, the amount in controversy exceeds the jurisdictional minimum of $75,000.

                            17          15.     Because there is complete diversity and the amount in controversy requirement is

                            18   satisfied, the Court has subject matter jurisdiction in this case pursuant to 28 U.S.C. §§ 1332 and

                            19   1441, and removal is proper.

                            20                                                 VENUE

                            21          16.     Removal is made to this Court in accordance with 28 U.S.C. §§ 1441(a) and 1446(a).

                            22   Venue is proper in this district because the action is currently pending in the Superior Court of the

                            23   State of California, Santa Clara County, which is within the Northern District of California.

                            24          17.     Removal to this Court is also proper pursuant to the Parties’ agreement. As alleged

                            25   in the Complaint, “the agreement at issue provides that the state and federal courts located in Santa

                            26   Clara County, California shall be the exclusive forum for any litigation concerning the agreement.”

                            27   Ex. A at 8 (Compl. ¶ 9).

                             1                                       RESERVATION OF RIGHTS

                             2           18.     Defendant denies the allegations contained in the Complaint and files this Notice of

                             3   Removal without waiving any defenses, objections, exceptions, and/or obligations that may exist in

                             4   its favor in either state or federal court.

                             5           19.     Further, Defendant does not concede in any way that (i) Plaintiff has asserted a claim

                             6   upon which relief can be granted, (ii) that Plaintiff has standing to bring the claim, and/or (iii) that

                             7   recovery of any of the amounts sought is authorized or appropriate.

                             8           20.     Defendant also reserves the right to amend or supplement this Notice of Removal.

                             9   Further, to the extent any questions arise as to the propriety of the removal of the action, Defendant

                            10   expressly requests the opportunity to present a brief, oral argument, and any further evidence

                            11   necessary in support of its position that this action is removable.
